name: Black Cultural Centre for Nova Scotia
description: Museum, archive, research hub and educational institution founded in 1983 to protect, promote and preserve African Nova Scotian history and culture.
address: 10 Cherry Brook Road, Cherry Brook, NS B2Z 1A6
access_requirements: Open to the public; some archival records require a request for access to protect sensitive information.
collection_summary: Community archive and museum collections on African Nova Scotian history (holdings not yet listed in this hub — partner staff add them through the portal).
geocode_query: Cherry Brook Road, Cherry Brook, Nova Scotia, Canada
geocode_note: No OpenStreetMap point of interest for the Centre; road-level match only.

name: Library of Congress
description: National library of the United States. Records come from its public catalogue via SRU; the LoC holds the physical items described.
access_requirements: Reading rooms are open to researchers 16+ with a free Reader Identification Card; items are requested through the catalogue.
collection_summary: Catalogue records retrieved for Black Nova Scotian / Black Canadian history queries.

name: Internet Archive
description: Non-profit digital library. Items are served online; the 'contributor' field names the library that supplied the scan and is shown as provenance only.
access_requirements: Open items are free to read online. Lending-library items require a free account (controlled digital lending).
collection_summary: Digitized texts, images and audio matching Black Nova Scotian / Black Canadian history queries.

name: Nova Scotia Archives
description: Provincial archives of Nova Scotia. Link-only directory entry: search its own catalogue and virtual exhibits (including African Nova Scotians in the Age of Slavery and Abolition).
access_requirements: Reading room open to the public; registration on arrival. Some records restricted.
geocode_query: Nova Scotia Archives, University Avenue, Halifax

name: Africville Museum
description: Museum in a replica of the Seaview United Baptist Church on the site of Africville, Halifax. Link-only directory entry.
access_requirements: Seasonal opening hours; check the website.

name: Library and Archives Canada
description: National library and archives of Canada. Link-only directory entry (Collection Search).
access_requirements: Free user card required for on-site consultation; many records digitized online.
geocode_query: Library and Archives Canada, 395 Wellington Street, Ottawa

name: Halifax Public Libraries (Central Library)
description: Public library system; the Central Library holds local-history and African Nova Scotian collections. Link-only: catalogue terms forbid scraping, so search it directly.
address: 5440 Spring Garden Rd, Halifax, NS B3J 1E9
access_requirements: Open to the public; borrowing requires a library card.
geocode_query: Halifax Central Library, Spring Garden Road, Halifax

name: Dalhousie University Archives
description: University archives with African Nova Scotian collections (community and personal fonds). Finding-aid descriptions come from its public OAI-PMH feed; the archive holds the physical material.
access_requirements: Reading room by appointment; see finding aids online.
geocode_query: Killam Memorial Library, Dalhousie University, Halifax
collection_summary: Finding-aid descriptions retrieved for Black Nova Scotian / Black Canadian history queries.

name: Black Loyalist Heritage Centre
description: Heritage centre at Birchtown, the largest free Black settlement outside Africa in the 18th century. Link-only directory entry.
address: 119 Old Birchtown Road, Birchtown, NS B0T 1B0
access_requirements: Seasonal; check the website for hours.
geocode_note: Only a locality-level match is available on OpenStreetMap.

name: MemoryNS (Council of Nova Scotia Archives)
description: Province-wide archival description portal. Link-only: ask the Council for an export before ingesting.

name: Canadian Museum for Human Rights
description: National museum in Winnipeg. Link-only directory entry.
address: 85 Israel Asper Way, Winnipeg, MB R3C 0L5
geocode_query: Canadian Museum for Human Rights, Winnipeg

name: Demo Partner (sample data)
description: A fictional partner used only to demonstrate the CSV import → review → publish workflow. Its records are real Open Library bibliographic entries, but the HOLDINGS are sample data: nobody has verified that any institution holds these copies.
access_requirements: Sample data — there is nothing to visit.
collection_summary: Sample CSV import (docs/partner-import-template.csv) built from real Open Library records.

name: The National Archives (UK)
description: The UK government's official archive at Kew. Colonial Office, Admiralty and Carleton papers include primary records of Black Loyalists, the Book of Negroes, the Sierra Leone settlers and the Jamaican Maroons in Nova Scotia. Records come from its Discovery API; TNA holds the physical documents.
access_requirements: Free reader's ticket (photo ID) to order original documents; many series can be downloaded as digital copies.
collection_summary: Catalogue records retrieved for Black Nova Scotian / Black Loyalist history queries (Kew holdings only).
geocode_query: The National Archives, Kew, Richmond, UK

name: Harvard Library
description: Harvard University's library system. Catalogue records come from the keyless LibraryCloud API; the holding repository (e.g. Widener Library) is taken from the record.
address: Widener Library, Harvard Yard, Cambridge, MA 02138
access_requirements: Visitors can apply for access at the Privileges Office; many e-resources need Harvard credentials.
collection_summary: Catalogue records retrieved for Black Nova Scotian / Black Canadian history queries.

name: Wikimedia Commons
description: Free media repository run by the Wikimedia Foundation. Files carry structured licence metadata; they are online items, not museum or archive holdings.
access_requirements: Open online under each file's licence.
collection_summary: Photographs, scans and maps matching Black Nova Scotian / Black Canadian history queries.

name: Nova Scotia Open Data Portal
description: Government of Nova Scotia open data (Socrata). Datasets such as 'African Nova Scotian Family Names by Region' are online resources under the Nova Scotia Open Government Licence.
collection_summary: Open datasets matching African Nova Scotian history queries.

name: Smithsonian Institution
description: US national museum complex; includes the National Museum of African American History and Culture (NMAAHC). Records come from the Smithsonian Open Access API when a key is set; the unit named on each record holds the object.
access_requirements: Museums are free to visit; archival material by appointment with the holding unit.
collection_summary: Catalogue records retrieved for Black history queries (requires SMITHSONIAN_API_KEY).
geocode_query: National Museum of African American History and Culture, Washington DC

name: The New York Public Library
description: Includes the Schomburg Center for Research in Black Culture. Records come from the NYPL Digital Collections API when a token is set; NYPL holds the originals.
address: 515 Malcolm X Blvd, New York, NY 10037
access_requirements: Free library card for on-site research; digital collections open online.
collection_summary: Digitised items retrieved for Black history queries (requires NYPL_API_TOKEN).
geocode_query: Schomburg Center for Research in Black Culture, New York
